Class ParallelState

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.parallel.ParallelState
public final class ParallelState extends Object
Per-rank view of a ParallelConfig mesh.

Phase 1: globalRank == tpRank with ppRank == 0. Phase 2 multi-node PP will set globalRank = ppRank * tpSize + tpRank.
